brief: Kosovo's Albanian-language media layer is broad but shallow on regulation: high-volume portals (Telegrafi, Koha, Bota Sot, Dukagjini, Insajderi) mostly republish BQK press material within hours, which makes them a fast tripwire but a poor primary source, while Ekonomia Online and Ekonomia.info provide the only sustained specialist economic coverage. Genuine added value comes from the BIRN network — Kallxo.com's BQK tag feeds in Albanian and Prishtina Insight / Balkan Insight in English — which is where supervisory failures, licensing disputes and political capture of the regulator actually get reported. KoSSev is the indispensable Serbian-language channel for the Serb-bank licensing dispute that Albanian outlets systematically under-cover. Critically, media do not report consultations as consultations: quiet consultation windows surface only via the BQK site, the Prime Minister's concept-document repository and the Assembly's draft-law register, so those three pointers must anchor the media layer rather than the other way round.
